note: Measures residual human sequence in deposited, host-filtered reads: the fraction of sampled reads whose longest exact Human472 match reaches the threshold. It is not the paper's pre-filtration host fraction and supports no host-fraction claim. Untimed; no timing from this screen is publishable.

parameters.selection: bottom-k pairs by SHA256(seed:run:pair-name), both mates as independent reads; every pair when a run has fewer
parameters.threshold_justification: Random exact matches against both strands of 472 haplotypes (about 3e12 bases) have expected longest length near log4(3e12 x 150), about 24 bases, for a 150-base read, and reach 31 by chance in roughly 1e-4 of reads. 50 bases is twice that expectation, so chance hits and short conserved or low-complexity stretches rarely count, while a 150-base human read at Illumina error rates almost always keeps an error-free stretch of 50 or more. Fractions at every grid threshold, including 31, are recorded.
parameters.usable_bases: ACGT bases after uppercasing; other bases split reads as in the historical cohorts
parameters.ranking: fraction of sampled reads with longest exact match >= threshold, descending; ties by usable bases descending, then run accession

tie_note: No eligible run shares the selected fraction
